subtitle: Open-Source AI Tools for Security, Audit, and DevOps

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: AI-assisted projects still need security scanning, audit trails, incident investigation, and deployment discipline.

sections.heading: Workflow controls
bullets: Review generated code like any other production change
Make scanners available before the agent asks for deployment
Record what changed, which tools ran, and which checks passed

sections.heading: Reason
sections.body: Make AI-assisted work easier to review, test, debug, and ship.
